Class LibraryService

java.lang.Object
library.service.LibraryService
public class LibraryService extends Object
Service class providing all book-related business logic and library operations. Handles adding, viewing, updating, deleting books, issuing, returning, reservations, search, filter, overdue tracking, and statistics. All validation is performed here, NOT in the GUI layer.
Author:
Usman

    • setStatus

      public Book setStatus(String id, BookStatus status) throws LibraryException
      Manually sets the status of a book (librarian action). Rules: the new status must differ from the current one, and a book with an active loan cannot be changed manually (it must be returned first). Switching to AVAILABLE clears issue/reservation details.
      Parameters:
      id - the book ID
      status - the new status
      Returns:
      the updated book
      Throws:
      LibraryException - if the ID is empty, the book is not found, the status is null, unchanged, or the book has an active loan

    • issueBook

      public Loan issueBook(String bookId, String memberId, int loanDays) throws LibraryException
      Issues a book to a member. Only AVAILABLE books (or books RESERVED by the same member) can be issued. Creates a loan record with issue date (today) and due date (today + loan period) using LocalDate.
      Parameters:
      bookId - the book ID to issue
      memberId - the member ID to issue to
      loanDays - the loan period in days (1 to 365)
      Returns:
      the created Loan
      Throws:
      LibraryException - if input is invalid or the book is not available for issue

    • issueBook

      public Loan issueBook(String bookId, String memberId, int loanDays, LocalDate issueDate) throws LibraryException
      Issues a book with an explicit issue date (used for seeding sample data and tests, e.g. to create a loan that is already overdue). Same rules as issueBook(String, String, int).
      Parameters:
      bookId - the book ID to issue
      memberId - the member ID to issue to
      loanDays - the loan period in days
      issueDate - the issue date (due date = issue date + loan days)
      Returns:
      the created Loan
      Throws:
      LibraryException - if input is invalid or the book is not available for issue
